resources.string: Browse 33 exercises across Pentatonic, Legato, Alternate Picking, Blues/Rock, Spider Warmups, and Jazz 7th Arpeggios.
Tap any step column on the tablature grid to audition that note, inspect its left-hand finger (1=Index .. 4=Pinky), and check the picking badge (D=Down, U=Up, H=Hammer, P=Pull, /=Slide).
Tap any string/fret on the zoomed 8-fret guitar neck to pluck that pitch directly through the 12-voice Karplus-Strong synth.
Tap KEY to shift all 33 exercises across the fretboard from E to Eb.
Tap LADDER to auto-increment BPM (+2, +5, or +10 BPM) every 2, 4, or 8 bars so your picking speed builds effortlessly.
Toggle LOOP between FULL BAR and BEAT 1 ONLY to isolate difficult 4-note picking cells before linking the full 16-step phrase.
Displays diatonic Roman numerals (Imaj7..viim7b5) and chord-tone intervals (1, 3, b3, 5, b5, 7, b7) with synthesized backing chords.
